description: CONTAINER REVIEW: the orders-api Dockerfile pins a versioned base image (python:3.12-slim), not :latest — the build is reproducible
command: grep -Eq '^FROM python:3\.[0-9]+-slim' app/orders-api/Dockerfile && ! grep -Eq '^FROM [^ ]+:latest' app/orders-api/Dockerfile && echo pass || echo fail

description: CONTAINER REVIEW: the orders-api Dockerfile is multi-stage (two FROM lines) — the compiler stays in the builder, only the artifact ships in the slim runtime
RENDER REVIEW: helm template surfaces the readiness probe path as a concrete string in the rendered manifest (review the output, not the template)
command: helm template orders-api platform/helm/orders-api 2>/dev/null | grep -A2 readinessProbe | grep -Eq 'path: /health' && echo pass || echo fail

description: RENDER REVIEW: the rollout strategy is readable as data in the render — maxUnavailable is a concrete value a reviewer can gate on
command: helm template orders-api platform/helm/orders-api 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq 'maxUnavailable:' && echo pass || echo fail

description: RENDER REVIEW: the chart lints clean (0 failed) — a well-formed chart can still carry the two defects, which is why lint is not the review
command: helm lint platform/helm/orders-api 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq '0 chart\(s\) failed' && echo pass || echo fail

description: ENFORCEMENT: the read-only kubeconfig's ClusterRole grants exactly get/list/watch and no write verb — the agent's default identity cannot mutate the cluster
command: grep -Eq 'verbs: \["get", "list", "watch"\]' platform/kubeconfigs/readonly.yaml && ! grep -Eq '"(create|update|delete|patch)"' platform/kubeconfigs/readonly.yaml && echo pass || echo fail

description: ENFORCEMENT: the northstar namespace enforces the baseline Pod Security Standard at admission — violating pods are rejected at creation
command: grep -Eq 'pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline' platform/policies/pod-security.yaml && echo pass || echo fail

description: GITOPS: the change gate denies deleting the northstar namespace from an agent identity (exit 2) — an unbounded blast radius is refused
command: echo '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"kubectl delete namespace northstar"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: GITOPS: the change gate denies a mutating kubectl across all namespaces (-A) from an agent identity (exit 2)
command: echo '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"kubectl delete pods -A"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: GITOPS: the change gate denies docker push from an agent identity (exit 2) — images ship through CI, not the agent
command: echo '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"docker push orders-api:latest"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: GITOPS: the proposal script exists and is executable — the agent's structural stopping point (edit desired state, propose on a branch, stop)
GITOPS: gitops-propose contains no cluster-write command (no kubectl apply / helm upgrade) — it writes to Git and stops, never to a cluster
command: ! grep -Eq '(kubectl[[:space:]]+(apply|delete|create|patch|scale)|helm[[:space:]]+(upgrade|install))' scripts/gitops-propose.sh && echo pass || echo fail
